newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen holding level, market negative.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen holding level, market negative.

text.p: Danish share prices opened a tad higher on Monday in a generally rather negative market after Wall Street and European falls on Friday, with dealers seeing prices holding though.
"It looks like we will keep to current levels. Late purchase orders could pull the market up as happened on Friday," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had gained 0.08 point to 153.05 at 0810 gmt, having closed 0.24 point higher on Friday. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom, 45-33-969650
